customer_initial_msg: How do I reset my password or recover my account?
agent_final_reply: To recover your Smart Job Tracker account, open the Sign in page and choose Forgot password. Enter the email on your account and follow the reset link. If the email does not arrive, check spam and confirm you used the same address as your account.

customer_initial_msg: I forgot my password and cannot sign in.
agent_final_reply: Use Forgot password on the Smart Job Tracker sign-in page to request a reset link. For security, never share your password or reset token with anyone.

customer_initial_msg: How do I add and track a job application?
agent_final_reply: Open Applications from the dashboard and choose Add application. Enter the company, role, job description, application date, and current stage. You can update the stage later as you move from Applied to OA, Interview, Offer, Rejected, or Withdrawn.

customer_initial_msg: How can I change the status of an application?
agent_final_reply: Open the application card or its details drawer and select the new stage. Smart Job Tracker keeps the latest status in your pipeline and preserves the application history.

Resume Match compares your uploaded resume with a job description using skills, experience, role relevance, and semantic similarity. It shows matched skills, missing skills, and an explainable score; the score is guidance, not a hiring prediction.

customer_initial_msg: How do I upload or replace my resume?
agent_final_reply: Open Resume Builder or Resume Match from the dashboard and upload a PDF or DOCX. Smart Job Tracker extracts the text for matching and profile features; the original file is not retained.

customer_initial_msg: Where do job listings come from and how do I discover jobs?
agent_final_reply: Open Discover jobs to search configured public career pages from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and other enabled sources. Listings are normalized and linked back to the original employer posting where you apply.

customer_initial_msg: Why are no jobs showing in my recommendations?
agent_final_reply: Set or broaden your job preferences, including target roles and locations, then run discovery again. Recommendations may be empty when filters are too narrow or a source is temporarily unavailable.

customer_initial_msg: How do I connect Gmail and what data is read?
agent_final_reply: Gmail is optional. From Profile or Connected services, choose Connect Gmail and complete Google's consent flow. Smart Job Tracker uses read-only access to identify recruitment emails and suggest application updates; you can disconnect it at any time.

customer_initial_msg: How do calendar reminders and follow-up reminders work?
agent_final_reply: Connect Google Calendar from Profile or Connected services, then configure reminders for follow-ups and interviews. You can disconnect the calendar integration and manage reminder timing from the app.

customer_initial_msg: How do I delete my account or disconnect Google data?
agent_final_reply: Open Profile and use the account or connected-service controls. Disconnect Gmail or Calendar to revoke the integration. For full account deletion or a data request, contact Smart Job Tracker support through the Support page.

customer_initial_msg: Is Smart Job Tracker free and is a credit card required?
agent_final_reply: Smart Job Tracker can be started without a credit card. Create an account to use the application pipeline, resume matching, job discovery, and reminders that are available for your account.

customer_initial_msg: How do I contact a human support specialist?
agent_final_reply: If the assistant cannot resolve your issue, use the Support page and include the email on your account plus a short description of the problem. Do not include passwords, reset tokens, or private OAuth credentials.

customer_initial_msg: I think my account or Google connection is unsafe.
agent_final_reply: Do not share passwords, reset tokens, or OAuth credentials in chat. Disconnect the affected Gmail or Calendar integration from Profile, change your password, and contact support for a security review.
